params.linkText: pricing of an underwritten public offering

children: of $45M aggregate principal amount of senior notes due 2031.
Net proceeds from the offering are expected to be approximately $43.7M after underwriting discounts and commissions, but before estimated offering expenses.

The notes will mature on October 1, 2031, and bear a fixed annual interest rate of 7.75%, payable quarterly beginning December 1, 2026. Issued in denominations of $25 and integral multiples thereof, the notes may be redeemed at Runway Growth’s option, in whole or in part, on or after October 1, 2028.
The company has granted underwriters a 30-day overallotment option to purchase up to an additional $6.75M in aggregate principal amount of notes.
The transaction is expected to close on October 1, 2026, with the notes expected to list on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker symbol "RWAYM."

Runway Growth plans to use the net proceeds from the offering to optimize its capital structure and reduce overall borrowing costs. The company intends to fully redeem its 9.00% senior notes due January 31, 2027, which had approximately $33.0M in principal outstanding as of September 24, 2026, pay down outstanding debt under its KeyBank National Association credit facility, and allocate any remaining funds toward general corporate purposes.
